title: zannichellia palustris subsp. pedicellata
intro: Zannichellia palustris subsp. pedicellata, commonly known as the Narrow-fruited Water-wort or Narrow-fruited Bitter-cress, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Alismataceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties which provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Zannichellia palustris subsp. pedicellata include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues, and its antispasmodic properties which can help alleviate muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
